name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
body: I'm based in Arvada, Colorado, Mountain time, not the Eastern time zone this role is scoped to. I'm flagging that upfront rather than hoping it doesn't come up.

You build with Claude Code and Codex, and I use Claude Code directly to build and maintain the Python automation pipeline behind my own job-search tooling, so that part of the role is already familiar territory. On the onboarding side, I ran technical onboarding and launch for 25-plus clients a month at Wix while leading a team of onboarding specialists, and at Birdeye I onboarded and trained a reseller partner network on technical product setup, retaining 94% of accounts. At Solenzo I write Python and JavaScript inside n8n, Zapier, and Make to extend automation beyond what's available out of the box, and I handle API integrations and technical configuration directly with clients.

I don't have hands-on monitoring or observability tooling experience, and I want to say that directly rather than stretch to cover it. What I bring is a fast learning curve on new technical stacks, real comfort with AI-assisted development tools, and 15 years of owning the customer relationship through onboarding and growth. If the time zone works, I'd welcome the conversation.
